triples.tail_surface: check the drive rotation to see that it matches the pump rotation
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 检查驱动旋转方向与泵旋转方向一致
triples.evidence_text: At initial startup, before bolting coupling halves together, check the drive rotation to see that it matches the pump rotation.

triples.tail_surface: Check the shaft alignment as covered in Installation
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 按安装章节检查轴对中
triples.evidence_text: Prior to each startup, check the shaft alignment as covered in Installation.

triples.tail_surface: Check the bearing and stuffing box for proper lubrication
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 检查轴承和填料函润滑是否适当
triples.evidence_text: Check the bearing and stuffing box for proper lubrication and install oil in pumps with oil lubricated bearings.

triples.tail_surface: Check to see that V-ring seals (if supplied) are properly seated against bearing covers
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 检查V型密封圈是否正确贴合轴承盖
triples.evidence_text: Check to see that V-ring seals (if supplied) are properly seated against bearing covers.

triples.tail_surface: oil must be added at initial startup
triples.evidence_text: Pumps having oil lubricated bearings are normally shipped without oil and oil must be added at initial startup.

triples.tail_surface: Check that the shaft turns freely by hand
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 手动检查泵轴转动是否灵活
triples.evidence_text: Check that the shaft turns freely by hand.

triples.tail_surface: Check that the shaft guard is in place
triples.evidence_text: Check that the shaft guard is in place.

triples.head_surface: valve in the pump suction line
triples.tail_surface: Open valve in the pump suction line, if fitted
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 打开泵吸入管路阀门（如装有）
triples.evidence_text: Open valve in the pump suction line, if fitted.

triples.tail_surface: open the vent valve on top of the pump casing. After all entrained air has escaped, close the vent valve
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 打开泵壳顶部排气阀，待空气排尽后关闭
triples.evidence_text: If the pump operates under positive pressure, open the vent valve on top of the pump casing. After all entrained air has escaped, close the vent valve.

triples.head_surface: air trapped in the impeller passages
triples.tail_surface: Rotate the shaft, if possible, to allow any air trapped in the impeller passages to escape
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 如可能则盘车使叶轮流道内空气排出
triples.evidence_text: Rotate the shaft, if possible, to allow any air trapped in the impeller passages to escape.

triples.tail_surface: fill the pump and suction line with liquid from an outside source. Trapped air should be allowed to escape through the vent valve while filing
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 用外部液源灌泵及吸入管路，灌注时经排气阀排出滞留空气
triples.evidence_text: If the pump operates on a suction lift and a foot valve is included in the system, fill the pump and suction line with liquid from an outside source. Trapped air should be allowed to escape through the vent valve while filing.

triples.tail_surface: use a vacuum pump or ejector operated by air, steam, water, etc., to evacuate air from the pump case and the suction line by connecting the ejector to the priming connection on top of the pump case
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 使用真空泵或喷射器从泵壳及吸入管路抽除空气
triples.evidence_text: If the pump operates on a suction lift and no foot valve is provided; use a vacuum pump or ejector operated by air, steam, water, etc., to evacuate air from the pump case and the suction line by connecting the ejector to the priming connection on top of the pump case.

triples.tail_surface: Open discharge valve slowly when the pump is up to speed
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 泵达到转速后缓慢打开排出阀
triples.evidence_text: Open discharge valve slowly when the pump is up to speed. CAUTION! Overheating and/or loss of prime will result if the pump is operated against a closed valve for more than a few minutes.
